runtimeSupport.scope: 实现 V1.2 的 240×240 ST7789 可见窗口、GPIO46 背光、CST816D 轮询坐标、BOOT0／USER17 与共用 SPI 总线的 SD；摄像头、音频、振动、充电器和触摸中断未实现。
unsupported: Factory firmware boot and full application behavior remain unverified; no physical hardware validation.

Only the zero-offset native glass window is modeled, not the undocumented outside-glass controller RAM or display readback. Normal factory MADCTL0/IPS inversion is sourced from the exact Arduino_GFX example/driver.

Touch register01 returns no gesture;02 reports contact and03..06 coordinates clamped to239. Identity/sleep/IRQ registers are unimplemented, so the full factory initialization may require more behavior before boot succeeds. IRQ47 remains its sourced idle high, without fake interrupts.
GPIO16 is AP1511B haptic drive in the schematic, not a guessed LCD power rail. Camera OV2640/OV5640 capture, microphone/speaker, haptic physics and SY6970 power control remain unmodeled.
runtimeSupport.firmwareCompatibility: No factory image is claimed working by a board protocol test.

conflicts.resolution: Selected both current pin_config.h copies and exact V1.2 schematic: CLK35/MOSI34/CS36/DC45/BL46 and no MCU reset pin. The old TFT_eSPI Setup304 uses different pins and BL3; it is retained as conflicting historical evidence and is not accepted by this board.
